respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture shows an automated data processing and search pipeline alongside a web application backend. S3 receives raw CSV/Excel files and triggers a validation Lambda, which writes validated data back to S3. Next, an ingestion Lambda is triggered to ingest the validated records into OpenSearch and write reporting data to S3, which initiates email notifications through SES. A web user also interacts with the Novetiq backend, which communicates with Amazon RDS and S3. Components b1 and b2 are kept as separate Lambda functions performing distinct validation and ingestion steps.
respuesta.nombre: Data Ingestion and Search Pipeline with OpenSearch and Novetiq Backend
